# Purpose

Low-serum RPMI wash medium used to wash the opened small intestine before stripping, and as the base medium for IEL Strip Medium (`BUF-IEL-STRIP`).

# Working buffer composition

**50 mL per mouse** (20 mL for intestinal washes + 20 mL as base for Strip Medium + ~10 mL margin).

| Component | Final concentration | Volume for 50 mL |
|---|---|---|
| RPMI 1640 | Base | 46.0 mL |
| FCS | 3% (v/v) | 1.5 mL |
| HEPES (1 M stock) | 2% (v/v) | 1.0 mL |
| Penicillin/Streptomycin (100x stock) | 1% (v/v) | 0.5 mL |
| L-glutamine (200 mM stock) | 1% (v/v) | 0.5 mL |

# Preparation

## A. Preparation of stock (if applicable)

Not applicable — prepared directly as the working buffer.

## B. Preparation of working buffer

1. Combine RPMI 1640 with FCS, HEPES, Penicillin/Streptomycin, and L-glutamine per the table above.
2. Mix gently by inversion.

# Storage and stability

- Can be prepared the evening before use and held at **4 °C**.
- Bring to room temperature or 37 °C (as needed) before use.
